notes.title: Version 1.0.15 Released
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Markers can now be added to the map
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.14 Released
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added Delivered Numbers screen which shows currently delivered numbers and speed of delivery
[*]Buildings can now be quickly replaced by building over them
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.12 Released
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Autosave functionality now uses 3 rotating save files.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.10 Released
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added parallelogramic selection mode (Hold Control+Shift when using Copy or Demolish tools).
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.7 Released
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added dark color theme.
[*] Controls can now be viewed in Options menu.
[*] Fixed achievements sometimes not unlocking.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.6 Released
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed bridges not working correctly when placed next to a storage building.
[*] Fixed numbers sometimes not getting removed when removing belts.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.5 Released
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added option to show resource markers on highest zoom level.
[*] Added ability to pause the game by pressing Space.
[*] Fixed buildings not outputting to bridges directly.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.4 Released
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added Storage Building (unlocked at level [spoiler]11[/spoiler]).
[*]Added copy/paste functionality (unlocked at level [spoiler]13[/spoiler]). Use Shift+Mouse Wheel to cycle clipboard history.
[*]Added automatic placement of bridges (hold shift while building belts).
[*]Enabled panning the map with the arrow keys.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.3 Released
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed incorrect placement of the upgrade tutorial dialog.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.2 Released
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added fullscreen toggle in the options menu.
[*]Added tutorial text: You can use Shift+Right Mouse to copy and Shift+Left Mouse to paste belt priorities.
[*]Fixed problem with toolbar buttons sometimes not working.
[*]Adjusted numbers for higher levels. Players on levels 21+ may see the current number change.[/list]
